system.description:
Vanguards are terrifying sentinels of heavy metal armor that use shields to devastate their foes, standing tall as mobile bastions of

fortitude and might.


Iconic Vanguards

• Groot, Guardians of the Galaxy

• Havel, Dark Souls

• Juggernaut, X-Men

• Reinhardt, Overwatch


Playing Vanguard

The vanguard is a high-defense tank, trading off raw damage output for control. Actively defend through the Rush Action and Shoves.


Action: Shove (Attack)

Move: Frontline

Starting Pack: Sentinel


Training: Melee, Brawl

features.name: Stalwart
features.description: You gain the Protector Perk (p. 71) and, when you take the Hold Action, you can use the held Action or Move as late as the end of your next Turn.

features.name: Guard
features.description: Once per Round, you can try to Shove a Close Target (no Action) when they become Close to you, or when you roll a Defense Weapon’s damage die.

features.name: Rampant Charge
features.description: You can push Targets you Shove ahead of you while you Move during the same Turn. If you push it into an occupied space, it deals your Weapon’s damage to the Target and whatever occupied the space.

features.name: Wall
features.description: You are considered Large for Shoves and the damage dice of Defense Weapons are one size larger while you have them Equipped. At 8th Level, you are considered Huge for Shoves and increase the damage die by another size.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.description: If you use Rampant Charge and push a Being into another, you can attempt to push the additional Being ahead of you as well.

features.name: Wall
features.description: You are considered Huge for Shoves and the damage dice of Defense Weapons are two sizes larger while you have them Equipped.

features.name: Indestructible
features.description: If you aren’t Incapacitated and are wearing Armor, you are Immune to attack damage.
